declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement in support of preliminary approval. Negotiations produced a $29 million fund for approximately 400,000 identifiable class members, with payments made automatically rather than through a claims process. We initially proposed a $32 million class fund; Brightline offered $27 million; we countered at $30 million; and Brightline offered $29 million, which we accepted. Fees were discussed alongside class relief from the first proposal, not only after agreement on class relief. The settlement provides for up to $2 million in separately paid, court-approved fees and expenses, with no clear-sailing provision and any unawarded amount going to the class. Those fees are payable to the foundation funding our flat-fee engagement and do not change our firm's compensation. In assessing the settlement, we considered the costs and delay of continued litigation, the unresolved certification risk, and our assessment of the prospects at trial. The automatic $29 million recovery represents approximately 45% of the $64 million in disputed charges and avoids those risks. We believe the settlement is fair to the class, subject to the Court's review and consideration of class members' views.
